summary_en: Open House Group will cancel 2,771,500 shares of common stock on October 30, 2026, representing 2.37% of shares outstanding before cancellation. The shares were acquired under a buyback program authorized on November 14, 2025, with a maximum acquisition of 5 million shares and 2.5 billion yen over the period from November 17, 2025 to September 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock (Progress on Disclosure Matters)
translation_en_brief:
Open House Group announced that the number of treasury shares to be cancelled has been confirmed. The company will cancel 2,771,500 shares of common stock on October 30, 2026, following a cancellation resolution adopted at the board meeting held on November 14, 2025. These shares represent 2.37% of outstanding shares prior to cancellation, bringing the total number of issued shares after cancellation to 114,012,300 shares.

The shares being cancelled were acquired under a buyback authorization also decided on November 14, 2025. The buyback program permitted the acquisition of up to 5 million shares with a maximum expenditure of 2.5 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 17, 2025 to September 30, 2026. The company acquired 2,771,500 shares, spending approximately 2.5 billion yen, representing 4.44% of issued shares excluding treasury stock at the time of the buyback authorization.
